q: How many customers do we have?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

q: How many products are there in each category?
gold: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY category

q: How many orders have status cancelled?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

q: List the distinct cities our customers live in.
gold: SELECT DISTINCT city FROM customers

q: What is the most expensive product? Give its name and price.
gold: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1

q: What is the average product price, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM products

q: How many customers are in each city?
gold: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY city

q: How many business customers are there?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE segment = 'business'

q: Count orders by status.
gold: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

q: What is the total quantity of items sold across all orders?
gold: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM order_items

q: What is the total revenue (quantity times unit price) across all order items, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity * unit_price), 2) FROM order_items

q: What is the total revenue from delivered orders only, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered'

q: Revenue by product category, rounded to 2 decimals.
gold: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category

q: Which 5 products sold the most units? Show name and units.
gold: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY units DESC, p.name LIMIT 5

q: Which city generated the most revenue? Give the city and revenue rounded to 2 decimals.
gold: SELECT c.city, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS rev FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many orders were placed in 2025?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'

q: How many orders were placed in 2026?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2027-01-01'

q: How many customers signed up in 2024?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date >= '2024-01-01' AND signup_date < '2025-01-01'

q: How many customers have never placed an order?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id)

q: Who are the top 3 customers by number of orders? Show name and order count.
gold: SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY n DESC, c.id LIMIT 3

q: What is the average number of items (order lines) per order, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 2) FROM order_items

q: What is the average order value (sum of quantity times unit price per order), rounded to 2 decimals?
gold: SELECT ROUND(AVG(v), 2) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS v FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t

q: List products priced above 300 with their prices.
gold: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > 300

q: How many products cost less than 50?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE price < 50

q: Which category has the most products?
gold: SELECT category FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, category LIMIT 1

q: How many returned orders are there per city?
gold: SELECT c.city, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'returned' GROUP BY c.city

q: What share of orders were cancelled, as a percentage rounded to 2 decimals?
gold: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) FROM orders

q: How many orders did business customers place?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'business'

q: Revenue by customer segment, rounded to 2 decimals.
gold: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

q: What is the earliest order date?
gold: SELECT MIN(order_date) FROM orders

q: What is the latest order date?
gold: SELECT MAX(order_date) FROM orders

q: How many distinct customers placed at least one order?
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders

q: Which product has never been ordered?
gold: SELECT name FROM products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM order_items oi WHERE oi.product_id = p.id)

q: How many pending orders are there in Hyderabad?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'pending' AND c.city = 'Hyderabad'

q: Total units of Dairy products sold.
gold: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.category = 'Dairy'

q: What is the highest single order value (quantity times unit price summed per order), rounded to 2 decimals?
gold: SELECT ROUND(MAX(v), 2) FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS v FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) t

q: Which order id has the highest order value?
gold: SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id ORDER BY SUM(quantity * unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many order lines have quantity 5?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE quantity = 5

q: Average price per category, rounded to 2 decimals.
gold: SELECT category, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) FROM products GROUP BY category

q: How many customers in Mumbai are business customers?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE city = 'Mumbai' AND segment = 'business'

q: Number of orders per customer segment.
gold: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

q: Which 3 cities have the most delivered orders? Show city and count.
gold: SELECT c.city, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY n DESC, c.city LIMIT 3

q: How many customers have placed more than 10 orders?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 10) t

q: What is the name of the cheapest product in the Staples category?
gold: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Staples' ORDER BY price ASC LIMIT 1

q: Total revenue from the Fruits category in 2026, rounded to 2 decimals.
gold: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE p.category = 'Fruits' AND o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2027-01-01'

q: How many orders were placed in October 2026?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-10-01' AND order_date < '2026-11-01'

q: Which customer spent the most in total? Give name and amount rounded to 2 decimals.
gold: SELECT c.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS spent FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many orders contain more than 3 distinct products?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT product_id) > 3) t

q: How many products are in the Bakery category?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products WHERE category = 'Bakery'

q: List the names of all Beverages products.
gold: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Beverages'

q: How many orders have status shipped or pending?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('shipped', 'pending')

q: What is the total number of units sold of 'Paneer 200g'?
gold: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE p.name = 'Paneer 200g'

q: How many cancelled orders did consumer-segment customers place?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'cancelled' AND c.segment = 'consumer'

q: Number of distinct products ordered by customers in Chennai.
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.city = 'Chennai'

q: Which category had the highest revenue? Name only.
gold: SELECT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) DESC LIMIT 1

q: How many customers signed up after June 30 2025?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE signup_date > '2025-06-30'

q: What is the average quantity per order line, rounded to 2 decimals?
gold: SELECT ROUND(AVG(quantity), 2) FROM order_items

q: How many orders were returned in 2025?
gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'returned' AND order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND order_date < '2026-01-01'

q: Top 5 customers by total units purchased: name and units.
gold: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY units DESC, c.id LIMIT 5

q: How many distinct cities have at least one business customer?
gold: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city) FROM customers WHERE segment = 'business'
